components: a left upright joined to the top bar
a middle upright hanging from the top bar
a right bowl that leaves the middle upright, curls below the baseline, and sweeps left into a descender
strokeOrder: start at the lower left and draw the left upright upward
without lifting, carry the top bar to the right
without lifting, make the short return left to the middle upright
without lifting, draw the middle upright straight down
without lifting, climb back up to the junction and descend around the outside of the right bowl
without lifting, turn through the bottom and sweep left into the below-baseline tail — and only now lift
strokeOrderNote: one stroke — the manual numbers six movements; native writers draw them without lifting, and this ductus follows them in order, climbing back up the middle upright to reach the right bowl; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I, Frame 5, ந

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 5, ந (University of Texas at Austin), p. 193
strokeOrderSource.variation: Module 5 identifies ந as the voiced dental nasal and notes that its extended final curve may be omitted. Appendix I Frame 5 numbers six hand-movements. Native writers draw them as one continuous stroke, and this ductus follows the six movements in order without lifting: the pen climbs back up the middle upright to where the right bowl leaves it. In HP Labs India's online Tamil handwriting data (the LipiTk 4.0 Tamil isolated-character recognizer, trained on hpl-tamil-iso-char), 85% of the 224 stored prototypes of ந are a single pen-down stroke. Tamil handwriting varies by school; this is one attested order fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline.

notes: The dental n, tongue against the teeth. Contrast ன (alveolar) and ண (retroflex). Frame 5's first row is ந; its six numbered movements are one continuous stroke: the left upright and top bar, the short return and middle descent, then the right bowl and the optional extended tail.
